name: dth/marketing
description: Reusable marketing campaign, acquisition, audience, attribution and analytics module for DTH business applications.

suggest.filament/filament: Host application should use Filament 4.13.x for the optional DTH Marketing administration UI.
suggest.dth/email: Provides Email Campaign integration through EmailMarketingBridge when available.
suggest.dth/crm: Persists Marketing contacts and leads in CRM when both modules are installed.
suggest.dth/commercial: Provides the service/package catalog used by campaigns and landing pages.
